availability.reason: Set elevenLabs.apiKey in ignored padstudio.local.json; the key is never read from project inputs.

acceptanceMatrix.evidence: Piper and ElevenLabs share explicit tts.synthesize without fallback.
Piper integration produces verified reusable WAV Results in automated tests.
ElevenLabs is bound to an exact single-use credit authorization.
Receipt-first recovery is idempotent and never repeats the provider POST.
Credentials are local-only and absent from project records and CLI output.

limits: This gate does not submit a paid provider request.
Automated provider responses are simulated; current provider catalog, quota and voice quality require a configured account.
A real Piper sample must still be listened to and reviewed in a project before claiming creative voice quality.
